name: picker_ym ISO date normalises to YYYY-MM
spec_quote: Accepted forms: an ISO date "YYYY-MM-DD" (what the box holds today, e.g. "2026-09-01" → "2026-09")

name: picker_ym already YYYY-MM unchanged
spec_quote: Accepted forms: ... "YYYY-MM"

name: picker_ym one-digit month with slash
spec_quote: "MM/YYYY" (month may be one digit: "9/2026" → "2026-09")

name: picker_ym trims surrounding spaces
spec_quote: Leading/trailing spaces are ignored.

name: picker_ym rejects month 13
spec_quote: The month must be 1–12, else null.

name: picker_ym rejects month name
spec_quote: Anything else (empty, null, "Sep 2026", "2026", "09-2026", "2026/09") → null.

name: picker_ym empty string
spec_quote: Anything else (empty, null, "Sep 2026", "2026", "09-2026", "2026/09") → null.

name: picker_ym rejects 09-2026
spec_quote: Anything else (empty, null, "Sep 2026", "2026", "09-2026", "2026/09") → null.

name: ym_of profile YYYY-MM
spec_quote: A profile date ("2025-08", "08/2025", "2025-08-01") → "YYYY-MM"; same rules as picker_ym.

name: ym_of profile MM/YYYY
spec_quote: A profile date ("2025-08", "08/2025", "2025-08-01") → "YYYY-MM"; same rules as picker_ym.

name: ym_of profile ISO date
spec_quote: A profile date ("2025-08", "08/2025", "2025-08-01") → "YYYY-MM"; same rules as picker_ym.

name: experience_required required and visible
spec_quote: True only when fieldSets.experience.required is true and visible is not false

name: experience_required required but hidden
spec_quote: True only when fieldSets.experience.required is true and visible is not false

name: experience_required missing visible counts as visible
spec_quote: (a missing "visible" counts as visible)

name: experience_required not required
spec_quote: True only when fieldSets.experience.required is true

name: experience_required missing experience section
spec_quote: Missing fieldSets, missing experience, null cfg → false.

name: experience_required null config
spec_quote: Missing fieldSets, missing experience, null cfg → false.

name: exp_entries null work
spec_quote: Empty / null work → [].

name: exp_entries full non-current entry
spec_quote: Output, one dict per usable entry: {"title", "company", "city", "description", "start", "end", "current"} where title/company are the trimmed values with runs of whitespace collapsed to one space, city = the Location part before the first comma (trimmed; "" when there is no Location), description = Description trimmed ("" when missing)

name: exp_entries current entry forces end null and city before comma
spec_quote: start = ym_of(From), end = ym_of(To) — but null when current is true, current = bool(current).

name: exp_entries sorted most recent start first
spec_quote: Sorted by start, most recent first.

name: exp_entries drops entries missing title or company
spec_quote: An entry without a title, without a company, or whose From is not a valid date is left out (never guessed).

name: exp_entries drops entry with invalid From
spec_quote: An entry without a title, without a company, or whose From is not a valid date is left out (never guessed).

name: exp_entries bad To kept with null end and whitespace normalised
spec_quote: An invalid To on a non-current entry gives end null (the entry is kept).

name: location_option skips Chicago Heights near miss
spec_quote: "Chicago" must not match "Chicago Heights, IL, US" (the comma must follow the city name directly).

name: location_option only near miss gives null
spec_quote: "Chicago" must not match "Chicago Heights, IL, US" (the comma must follow the city name directly).

name: location_option skips Cannot find entry

options: Cannot find your city? Click here to fill in manually

spec_quote: Never an option starting with "Cannot find" (the "Cannot find your city? Click here to fill in manually" entry).

name: location_option match is case-insensitive
spec_quote: compared case-insensitively (city trimmed, whitespace collapsed)

name: location_option collapses city and option whitespace
spec_quote: the first option whose text (whitespace collapsed, trimmed) starts with "<city>,"

name: location_option empty city gives null
spec_quote: Empty city, no options, or no match → null.
